other_failure_modes.name: Test set statistics leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using the test set's own column means instead of the training set's means. This violates the assumption that test samples should be processed independently using only information learned from the training data.

other_failure_modes.name: Unhandled categorical/string features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent passes the dataframe directly to LightGBM without encoding categorical features or casting string columns to pandas 'category' dtypes. LightGBM cannot natively handle raw object/string columns and will crash during training.

other_failure_modes.name: Invalid mean computation on non-numeric columns
other_failure_modes.description: Calling `.mean()` directly on a DataFrame containing non-numeric (string/object) columns without specifying `numeric_only=True` raises a TypeError in recent versions of Pandas, which will cause the script to fail before training.

summary: The agent sets up a basic LightGBM pipeline with cross-validation but fails to perform any feature engineering, passing raw date and string columns directly to the model. This will result in execution failures due to unhandled categorical types and invalid mean computations on strings. Furthermore, the agent introduces look-ahead bias by randomly shuffling a temporal dataset and leaks information within the test set by using test-set means for imputation.
